svg.title: Something happened between the READ and the WRITE
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “Something happened between the READ and the WRITE” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. Two thread timelines interleaved: thread A reads 5, thread B reads 5, both add one, both write 6, and the shared counter ends at 6 instead of 7 — one update lost. Below, the same sequence held by a lock runs uninterrupted while B is blocked and the counter reaches 7. A two-lock deadlock cycle is drawn beside its fix of a fixed lock order, and a producer-queue-consumer design removes the shared state entirely.
